name: Granular Cloud
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' asynchronous grain cloud: four windowed sine grains respawning on a coin flip, each taking a fresh random pitch. Where Granular Formant stays locked to a carrier, this one scatters until the pitch is gone.

controls.label: Scatter
controls.description: Widens the random pitch each grain takes when it respawns, from unison to a cloud with no pitch left.

controls.label: Grain
controls.description: Sets grain length, from long overlapping windows down to short ones that respawn far more often.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Slides where the grain window peaks, from a reversed swell through the module's symmetric window to a struck grain.

controls.label: Density
controls.description: Sets how readily a finished grain respawns, from a sputtering cloud full of gaps up to four voices that never leave one.

outputs.main: Mono: all four grains summed. Stereo: the left side of the fixed four-grain pan spread.
outputs.aux: Mono: the cloud's amplitude on one steady tone at the played pitch. Stereo: the right side of the four-grain pan spread.

trigger: The engine itself ignores TRIG and its grains keep running; Plaits' shared envelope still shapes a patched note.
